catalog.title: DiveDay common dive sites
catalog.description: Published, versioned starting points. Importing makes an independent site in your own library; later template updates never overwrite your edits.
catalog.locationRequiredDescription: Set your shop's address and location in settings.

form.unsavedInSections: {count, plural, one {Unsaved changes in # section} other {Unsaved changes in # sections}}
form.forecastDescription: The offshore dive point, not the shop address. Leave both blank to keep the site off divers' maps.
form.photosDescription: Upload the pictures a diver sees on this site's briefing.
form.tooManyPhotos: {max, plural, one {A site holds up to # photo.} other {A site holds up to # photos.}}

route.description: Click the map to drop a waypoint, in the order you swim them. The map can't be dragged: the line you draw is the line a diver sees.
route.needsCoordinates: Fill in the GPS location above and the map appears here, ready to draw on.
route.notePlaceholder: A relaxed sweep from the mooring along the coral ridge and back.
route.mapAriaLabel: Map — click to add a route waypoint

status.one: One waypoint down. Click where it goes next.
status.full: That's the most waypoints a route can carry ({count}). Undo to change one.

form.difficultyUnset: Not said — the crew will call it
form.maxDepthHint: (optional · warns when a diver's certification doesn't reach it)
form.expectedBottomTimeHint: (optional · overrides your shop's usual bottom time)
form.divePlanPlaceholder: Entry, route, turnaround, and exit notes.
form.conservationNoteHint: Optional shop-stated guidance for divers at this site.
form.conservationNotePlaceholder: Marine park rules, mooring buoy use, buoyancy awareness, or local reef protection guidelines.
form.fitDescription: The line a diver reads above the site facts. Left on “work it out”, DiveDay guesses it from the difficulty, depth and current below.
form.fitToneDerive: Work it out from the facts below
form.fitNoteLabel: Say it in your own words
form.fitNotePlaceholder: Shallow, sheltered, and a good first ocean dive after a pool course.

landmarks.description: List a landmark even without a note, because divers look for the name.
landmarks.notePlaceholder: The easiest above-water reference, and a good way to stay oriented.
landmarks.empty: No landmarks yet. Add the first thing your crew points at.
landmarks.full: {max, plural, one {That's the most landmarks one site can carry (#).} other {That's the most landmarks one site can carry (#).}}

fieldGuide.description: Each card is written for you, in the language the diver is reading.
fieldGuide.full: {max, plural, one {That's the most species one guide can hold (#).} other {That's the most species one guide can hold (#).}}
fieldGuide.requestSent: Thanks, we have noted {name}. It arrives in a release, not today.

form.tipsHeadingHint: (optional · DiveDay writes one if you don't)
form.noLevelRequired: No level required by the site
form.errorCoordinates: Add both GPS coordinates. A location needs a latitude and a longitude.
form.errorDepth: That maximum depth is deeper than any dive site.
form.errorImages: One of those photos couldn't be stored. A site holds up to six, and each has to be a JPG, PNG, WebP, or HEIC under 5 MB. Everything else you typed is still here.
form.errorImagesUnconfigured: Photo storage isn't set up for this shop yet. Save the briefing without photos for now, or ask your shop's owner or manager to configure it.
form.errorConflict: Somebody else changed this briefing while you had it open, so nothing was saved. What you typed is still here. Copy anything you need, then reload the page.
form.errorNameTaken: Another dive site here already goes by that name, and a deleted one still holds its name too. Give this briefing a name of its own and save again. Everything else you typed is still here.

edit.description: Changes reach every upcoming dive that visits this site.
edit.deleteConfirmBody: It leaves your active library and your new-trip choices.
edit.errorInvalid: That didn't save. Check the name and links, then try again.

templateUpdates.title: A newer DiveDay template is ready
templateUpdates.description: This site is on template v{current}; the latest published version is v{latest}.
templateUpdates.keepEditsDescription: Pull the update while keeping fields you changed locally. Photos, routes, and the site name always stay yours.
templateUpdates.keepEditsHint: Only fields still matching the old template change. Your edits stay intact.
templateUpdates.replaceCopyHint: Use every field from the new template, while keeping your name, photos, and routes.
templateUpdates.replaceConfirm: Replace this site's template-managed copy with the latest published version?
templateUpdates.updated: Template update pulled in. Your edits were kept.
templateUpdates.replaced: Template update pulled in. Template copy replaced.
templateUpdates.undone: Template update undone. Your previous site copy is back.
templateUpdates.unavailable: That template update is no longer available. Refresh the page and try again.
templateUpdates.noFieldChanges: The published version changed its source record, but none of the fields this site uses need a content change.
